runtimeArchitectureDecision.nonMarketing: ONE_DOMAIN_SCOPED_METHODOLOGY_BUNDLE_PER_DOMAIN; DO_NOT MERGE ALL FIVE DOMAINS INTO ONE ASSESSMENT ROUTING SPACE
runtimeArchitectureDecision.why: Each diagnosis is separately paid, separately run and separately reported. The current Assessment engine binds one methodologyVersion per assessment, which naturally supports a domain-scoped methodology bundle.
requiredPersistenceBeforeActivation: domainCode on Assessment or a deterministic immutable methodology->domain binding

mappingRules: Marketing QuestionID has 12,288/12,288 exact runtime ID matches, but canonical wording/options are a different content version; do not overwrite the active Marketing bundle in place.
HRMRI/FINMRI/ISMRI/OPMRI canonical QuestionIDs have no exact ID match in the legacy repaired banks; do not map by row position, category ordinal or answer order.
Build new non-Marketing runtime bundles from canonical IDs and explicit runtime scoring/evidence policies.
Unknown, confidentiality refusal, no-eligible-case and factual N/A are non-zero states and must remain distinguishable.
Q3/Q4 are corroboration/conflict-resolution evidence paths and must not create a second maturity score.
Five strategic goals in each non-Marketing domain retain 20% baseline influence before valid N/A re-normalization within the owning goal.
step7RequiredImplementation: Create domain-scoped DB migration and API/billing contract.
Generate four validated non-Marketing methodology bundles with explicit QuestionOption score/state and QuestionRuntimePolicy mappings.
Wire frontend area IDs to backend domainCode and entitlement domainCode.
Keep existing Marketing methodology selectable and unchanged.
Run synthetic strong/mid/weak/unknown/N/A tests per domain.
Run payment/unlock/retake, resume/back/undo, report gating/PDF, traceability and rollback tests for all five domains.
Only after every activation gate passes, promote the four new domain bundles and freeze final hashes.
